title: Zesty Earthy Uruguayan Cheese Empanadas
description: A crowd-pleasing Uruguayan dish featuring earthy flavors and a cheese pull, made with tobiko and cure, this recipe is low-calorie-friendly and perfect for any meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine whole wheat flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add olive oil and water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of Uruguayan cheese, a sprinkle of tobiko, and a pinch of cure in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
